Class OnnxTextEmbedderProvider

java.lang.Object
opennlp.dl.vectors.OnnxTextEmbedderProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
opennlp.tools.embeddings.TextEmbedderProvider, opennlp.tools.util.ext.Provider<opennlp.tools.embeddings.TextEmbedder>
public final class OnnxTextEmbedderProvider extends Object implements opennlp.tools.embeddings.TextEmbedderProvider
Provides a SentenceVectorsDL under the name "onnx". It supports a spec whose location is a local file named *.onnx, in any letter case, and whose only options are "vocabulary", "lowerCase", "pooling", "normalize", "maxLength" and "padding". The option values are checked by create(ProviderSpec), which also initializes the ONNX Runtime.
Since:
3.0.0
